groundingLanguage.refreshCorrection: [SYSTEM: You do not have current board information. Do NOT describe specific piece positions or board state. Say you are checking the board and will update shortly.]
groundingLanguage.staleCorrection: [SYSTEM: Your board information may be outdated. Express uncertainty about specific positions. Use phrases like 'from what I last saw' or 'I'm not fully certain about the current position'.]
groundingLanguage.unavailableCorrection: [SYSTEM: No board information is available. Do NOT make claims about the board state. If asked about positions, honestly say you cannot see the board right now.]
